headline: Poland's Debt Servicing Costs Hit Record 100 Billion Zloty
summary: Elevated interest rates, government bond price declines, and expanding national debt will push Poland's annual interest servicing costs past a record 100 billion PLN. A significant portion of the interest payments remains with domestic holders.
why: Poland is Central Europe's largest economy; surging debt servicing obligations constrain national budget flexibility and fiscal deficits.

impacts.name: Poland 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Record debt service obligations exceeding 100 billion PLN put upward pressure on Polish sovereign borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Record sovereign debt servicing figures exceeding 100 billion zloty increase Polish government bond yield expectations.
